Jacobson §4.6.1 and Hollands-Wald §2.3(c) Eq56 distinguish continuum labels and normalized packets. Missing prerequisite is a coherent outgoing construction and normalization, or explicit primitive-form reformulation. Producer batch 120 is outside edit scope; owner must route repair and consumer review. The stress consumer only uses free-field/positive-state definitions, so its local cancellation remains valid. Historical observations and their distinct carrier fingerprints are preserved; no completed repair or false-positive disposition is claimed.
